summary: LM Funding America filed a Form 8-K furnishing a Bitcoin production update for May 2026 and announcing a strategic expansion into high-performance computing (HPC) and AI infrastructure. The company ordered initial GPU hardware for deployment at its Oklahoma facility and is marketing available power capacity at both facilities to AI co-location customers. The expansion will use its existing 26 MW operational power infrastructure. This filing discloses routine operational updates and a business strategy pivot. No deal terms, M&A activity, or special-situation event is present; the filing reports standard results and forward-looking plans.
